notes: RMV day ticket 6 EUR (central zone). The airport is 15 minutes by S-Bahn (Europe's main transfer hub). Take the RE train to Heidelberg and Rüdesheim; the Hessen-Ticket is cheap for groups.

December brings the Römerberg Christmas market (one of Germany's oldest). Winter is 0-5°C, so plan for museums (2-day Museumsufer ticket) and concerts at the Alte Oper. Spring is the time for the Palmengarten.
Apfelwein 0.3 l 2.50 EUR (served in a Bembel jug), Grüne Soße 12, Schnitzel 18, museums 8-18. Round up the bill as a tip.
Museumsufer Ticket 21 EUR for 34 museums over 2 days. Städel closed Mondays; Kleinmarkthalle closed Sundays; flea market on Saturdays.
The Bahnhofsviertel (station district) has a drug scene: pass through by day and avoid it at night. For evening bars, head to Sachsenhausen.
Frankfurter Würstchen, Handkäs mit Musik (onion-marinated cheese), Bethmännchen (marzipan-almond cookies), Frankfurter Kranz.

stops.name: Römerberg
stops.tips: Rebuilt half-timbered square with the Römer town hall. Empty before 09:30; Christmas market in December.

stops.name: Frankfurter Dom
stops.tips: The emperors' coronation cathedral. Tower climb 3 EUR (328 steps).

stops.name: Kleinmarkthalle
stops.tips: Covered market opened in 1954 with 60+ stalls. Try Grüne Soße (green sauce with 7 herbs), Frankfurter sausage and the wine stand upstairs. Closed Sundays.

stops.name: Main Tower
stops.tips: 200 m observation deck with views of the 'Mainhattan' skyline and the Taunus.

stops.name: Eiserner Steg & Main Kıyısı
stops.tips: Iron footbridge covered in love locks. Cross to Sachsenhausen and walk the riverfront promenade.

backups.name: Zum Gemalten Haus Sachsenhausen
backups.tips: Apfelwein (apple wine) tavern. Order Handkäs mit Musik.

backups.name: Historisches Museum Frankfurt
backups.tips: City history and models. Swap in for the tower.

stops.name: Städel Museum
stops.tips: 700 years of European art: Vermeer, Botticelli, Beckmann, Richter. Museumsufer ticket 21 EUR (34 museums, 2 days). Closed Mondays.

stops.name: Städel Café Holbein's
stops.tips: Museum café for lunch.

stops.name: Liebieghaus
stops.tips: Sculpture museum in a villa, with a garden café.

stops.name: Deutsches Filmmuseum
stops.tips: Interactive history of cinema on the Museumsufer.

stops.name: Museum Angewandte Kunst
stops.tips: Richard Meier's white design museum, with a park.

backups.name: Museum für Moderne Kunst MMK
backups.tips: 'Slice of cake' building with contemporary art. Swap in for the Filmmuseum.

backups.name: Maincafé Sachsenhausen
backups.tips: Riverside café with a lawn. Best in summer.

stops.name: Heidelberg Castle
stops.tips: 1 hour by train (RE). Ruined red sandstone castle above the Neckar, with a funicular, the world's largest wine barrel and the Pharmacy Museum.

stops.name: Old Bridge Heidelberg
stops.tips: 1788 stone bridge with the monkey statue, and a view toward the Philosophenweg.

stops.name: Zum Roten Ochsen
stops.tips: Student tavern from 1703. Mark Twain ate here. Order the Schnitzel.

stops.name: Hauptstraße & Universitätsplatz
stops.tips: Germany's longest pedestrian street at 1.6 km. Visit the Student Prison (Studentenkarzer, 4 EUR).

stops.name: Philosophenweg
stops.tips: The Philosophers' Walk on the far bank of the Neckar, with postcard views of the castle and old town. Then take the train back.

backups.name: Königstuhl Bergbahn
backups.tips: Funicular up the 568 m hill, with views over the Rhine plain. Swap in for the walk.

backups.name: Café Knösel Heidelberg
backups.tips: Café from 1863. Try the Heidelberger Studentenkuss chocolate.

stops.name: Palmengarten
stops.tips: Botanical garden from 1871 with a palm house and tropical greenhouse. Lovely in a German spring.

stops.name: Grüneburgpark
stops.tips: Former Rothschild park with a Korean garden and the IG Farben building (now the university).

stops.name: Senckenberg Naturmuseum
stops.tips: Germany's largest dinosaur collection, including a T. rex and Messel fossils.

stops.name: Bornheim Berger Straße
stops.tips: Café street in the 'Bernem' district. Stop at Apfelwein Solzer.

stops.name: Günthersburgpark
stops.tips: Neighbourhood park with a rose garden.

backups.name: Goethe House
backups.tips: The house where Goethe was born, in the centre. Swap in for Senckenberg.

stops.name: Rüdesheim Drosselgasse
stops.tips: 1 hour by train (RB). A 144 m wine alley: touristy but charming.

stops.name: Niederwalddenkmal Cable Car
stops.tips: Cable car above the vineyards to the Germania monument and views of the Rhine bend, in the UNESCO Middle Rhine valley.

stops.name: Rüdesheimer Schloss
stops.tips: Riesling tasting and Rüdesheimer Kaffee (coffee with Asbach brandy, flambéed).

stops.name: KD Rhine Boat Rüdesheim–St. Goar
stops.tips: Boats are limited in winter. Alternatively, take the cable car and walk to Assmannshausen, or visit Eberbach Abbey (The Name of the Rose set).

stops.name: St. Goar & Burg Rheinfels
stops.tips: Town opposite the Loreley with a ruined castle. The train back takes 1.5 hours.

backups.name: Kloster Eberbach
backups.tips: Cistercian monastery from 1136, with wine. Filming location for The Name of the Rose. Swap in for the boat.

backups.name: Breuer's Rüdesheimer Schloss Restaurant
backups.tips: The hotel's own restaurant. Try the Rhine fish.

stops.name: Höchst Altstadt
stops.tips: 15 minutes by S-Bahn. Half-timbered old town, Justinuskirche (830), Bolongaro Palace and the Main ferry.

stops.name: Alt-Sachsenhausen Lunch Apfelwein Wagner
stops.tips: Apfelwein tavern from 1931. Schnitzel mit Grüner Soße at long shared tables.

stops.name: Sachsenhausen Cobbled Streets
stops.tips: Klappergasse and the Kuhhirtenturm tower. Bar district in the evening.

stops.name: Museum Giersch
stops.tips: Art of the Rhine-Main region in a villa on the Museumsufer.

stops.name: Frankfurt Flohmarkt Sachsenhausen
stops.tips: Saturday flea market on the Main riverbank (every two weeks). On other days, walk along the river.

backups.name: Ebbelwoi-Express Tram
backups.tips: Nostalgic tram tour with apple wine (weekends). Swap in for the streets.

stops.name: Alte Oper
stops.tips: Opera house from 1880, with a fountain on the square.

stops.name: Zeil & MyZeil
stops.tips: Germany's busiest shopping street. MyZeil is the mall with the glass funnel.

stops.name: Café Hauptwache
stops.tips: Café in the 1730 baroque guardhouse. Say your farewell here.

stops.name: Hauptwache S-Bahn Airport
stops.tips: S8/S9 to the airport takes 15 minutes. Farewell.

backups.name: Konstablerwache Farmers Market
backups.tips: Market on Thursday to Saturday, with an apfelwein stand.

backups.name: Eschenheimer Turm
backups.tips: Medieval tower from 1428. Swap in for the opera.
